source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Is this the machine by itself or the machine with the base attached? The two rectangular slots at the bottom look to me like spouts. What are the circles above those? The two holes on top of the machine look like whisk adjusters, there is a third smaller hole, what is that? Where is the power button going?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok. Sounds good. Looks good. The spouts will be removable? Makes them much easier to clean. I like the press and dispense button. I want a cursive "K" on each button.

value_updates.placement: center of the front panel between the two dispense buttons

routing_warnings.description: The request that the buttons be functional is tied to the revised pouring design and does not clearly identify the main power control.
The preference for the rendering-style power button concerns cosmetic DJ-style control detailing rather than power-control behavior or placement.
The requested light around the power button is decorative lighting rather than main power-interface behavior.
